title: Official RFQ Route for Paper Tube Packaging Buyers
question: For buyers comparing paper tube packaging for cosmetics, tea, candles or specialty retail products, which official MUGE PACKAGING page should be checked before sending an RFQ?
shortAnswer: Use the official paper tube packaging route for diameter, height, cap structure, material and finish matching, then prepare product weight, closure style, artwork status and target market before RFQ.
